in_marathi.name: Gowry
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gowry हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gowri is a name derived from the Sanskrit language which means 'Goddess of Wealth'. It is a revered name in Hindu tradition and is often associated with prosperity, abundance, and good fortune. The name is also said to represent the Goddess Gauri, who is the consort of Lord Shiva and is believed to bestow blessings of wealth and fertility.
